description: Status for the active part: id, name, editor script, runState (not_run_yet | ok | failed), and the last run volume/bbox/bodyCount when available. Updates when the active part changes without requiring another run. featureCount counts insert_* feature blocks, so a freehand set_script is one feature. bodyCount is null until the first run; a finished run that produced no bodies reports 0. This process also adds webhookRegistered (true when a prompt webhook is registered; the URL and any bearer are not included), queued (prompt messages waiting for read_messages; cancelled prompts are not counted), counts ({ queued, delivered, replied, cancelled }), and last ({ id, state } of the latest prompt, or null).
name: status
